lines.zh: 我的脚掌压出一串深坑。
lines.en: My feet press out a line of deep pits.
The mud sinks wherever I tread the bank.

lines.zh: 我跟那头棘龙，谁也不让路。
lines.en: That Spinosaurus and I never yield the path.
Long legs stride, and the ground trembles.
I follow the scent of prey.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼般的牙在嘴里磕响。
lines.en: My shark-like teeth click together as I walk.
Step by step I patrol my territory.

lines.zh: 林间的影子里，我慢慢穿行。
lines.en: I move slowly through the forest shadows.

lines.zh: 这具身子很长，转身要费点劲。
lines.en: My body is long; turning takes effort.

lines.zh: 我踏过枯枝，它们碎成粉。
lines.en: I step on dry branches and they crumble.

lines.zh: 走在这片河口，我说了算。
lines.en: In this river mouth, I decide things.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫开草丛，为我开路。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the brush aside to clear my way.

lines.zh: 我要去看看西边那条水道。
lines.en: I want to check that channel to the west.

lines.zh: 缓慢，沉稳，这就是我的步伐。
lines.en: Slow and heavy, that is my walk.

lines.zh: 我站着，让太阳晒暖脊背。
lines.en: I stand and let the sun warm my spine.

lines.zh: 风里有血味，我慢慢分辨。
lines.en: There is blood on the wind; I sort it out slowly.
I raise my head and say nothing.

lines.zh: 这具头骨太轻，我得小心。
lines.en: This skull is too light; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 静立时，我像一段倒下的树干。
lines.en: Standing still, I look like a fallen trunk.
I watch the water, waiting for someone to move first.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼一样的牙，排满一张嘴。
lines.en: Shark-like teeth line this whole jaw.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被打扰的午后。
lines.en: I dislike an afternoon that gets disturbed.
Those little fish swim far too fast.
I am waiting for the Spinosaurus to move on.
Standing long enough, even my legs grow heavy.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半片河滩。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the riverbank.
Be quiet; I am listening.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，只有我最大。
lines.en: In this forest, I am the largest thing.

lines.zh: 你太矮，我低头才看见你。
lines.en: You're so short I had to look down.

lines.zh: 我低下头，凑近你这小东西。
lines.en: I lower my head to this small thing you are.
Is your meat enough for one bite?
No scales on you; easy to bite.
I narrow my eyes and sniff your scent.
Don't stand right in the middle of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过这种猎物了。
lines.en: I have not seen this kind of prey in a long while.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我看得更清楚。
lines.en: You look up at me; I see you better.

lines.zh: 你在我的领地里站得太久了。
lines.en: You have stood in my territory too long.
My teeth are harder than your bones.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，就知道跑不快。
lines.en: One look tells me you cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向一边，继续看。
lines.en: I tilt my head and keep watching.
That knocked my head askew.
You dare bite me?
An old wound splits across my skull.
Don't touch my skull!
I back off half a step, teeth still bared.
It stings, but it is nothing.
Try hitting me and see.

lines.zh: 血味进了鼻子，我更兴奋。
lines.en: Blood in my nostrils only excites me.
I will return this blow to you.
My skull is light; I can't take heavy blows.
That meat smell has crawled into my nose.

lines.zh: 把那块肉丢下来，我等着。
lines.en: Drop that meat down here; I'm waiting.
Don't run; I smell something fresh.

lines.zh: 血腥味让我顾不上别的。
lines.en: The smell of blood crowds out everything else.
I lower my long head and come closer.
This small bite, I won't call it too little.
My shark teeth are starting to itch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟，别以为我想聊天。
lines.en: I follow slowly; don't think I want to chat.
That smell pulls at my stomach.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我够不太到。
lines.en: Hold it higher; I can barely reach.

lines.zh: 被我这身撞一下，够你飞。
lines.en: Get bumped by this body and you'll fly.
I had no plan to step aside.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的肋上，像撞墙。
lines.en: You hit my ribs like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 退后，我踩过去不打招呼。
lines.en: Back up; I don't announce my steps.

lines.zh: 我身上的伤够多，不差你这一下。
lines.en: I carry plenty of scars; yours won't matter.
I fought for this path; don't crowd it.
One shove of my shoulder and you stagger.
I haven't even swung my tail yet.
Bumping into me counts as a challenge.
You are too light to even feel.
Another great beast has come near.
We walk the riverbank side by side.
At a time like this, I put my teeth away.
Our footprints line up as one.

lines.zh: 这片领地够养我们的后代。
lines.en: This territory can feed our young.
I rumble low, which counts as a greeting.
Big skull rests against big skull.
We patrol the border together.
Careful, my bones are light.
This season, the river mouth is quiet.
I pick up this bone in my jaws.
Who dropped this meat? Mine now.
I lower my head and carry it off.
This might be useful; I'll keep it.
My teeth make it easy to carry.

lines.zh: 我在泥里翻找的时候常捡到东西。
lines.en: I often find things while rooting in the mud.
Let me taste it before deciding.
I tuck it by my cheek and take it back.
Little thing, don't waste it.
I carry it on and keep patrolling.
That prey is mine.
My shark teeth have chosen it.
I see its legs going weak.
Target chosen; don't compete.

lines.zh: 我的牙像鲨鱼，头骨却很脆。
lines.en: My teeth are shark-like, my skull is brittle.
I pick the meat on this path first.
It cannot leave my territory.

lines.zh: 我的牙像鲨鱼，头骨却脆。
lines.en: Shark-like teeth, and a brittle skull.
Good, I'll start with it.

lines.zh: 那头棘龙又来了，我盯住它。
lines.en: That Spinosaurus is back; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 鲨齿的鼻子，先闻到你了。
lines.en: My shark-toothed snout smelled you first.
Its scent has grown thick.
I decide to chase this one.
The prey is just past the river bend.

lines.zh: 我压低巨大的头，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lower my huge head and creep closer.
Shark teeth, in my jaw.
My footsteps make it tremble.
A little closer, and my teeth will do.
I go around the big rock.

lines.zh: 它躲进树后，我看见尾巴了。
lines.en: It hides behind a tree; I see the tail.
Patience; I wait better than it does.
A roar is stored in my throat.
There is no second road on this bank.
The shark-like teeth are already clenched.
I deliberately slow my steps.

lines.zh: 我还记得它刚才的动静。
lines.en: I still recall how it moved.
At the border, it can no longer get out.
I have waited long for this bite.
The wind has turned; it cannot smell me.
I bite down, and bone cracks.
My shark teeth tear through its hide.

lines.zh: 这一口够它半天爬不起来。
lines.en: This bite will keep it down a while.
One shake of my head flips you over.
My neck drops and the teeth go in.
Once bitten, there is no running.
Red sprays across the riverbank.
I always bite at the side of the neck.
Don't resist; save your strength.
One shove of my big head and it's done.
The tooth marks will linger long.
Biting alone is enough for me.
I pin it into the mud.

lines.zh: 这声惨叫，整片林子都听见。
lines.en: That scream carries through the whole forest.
I walk out of the deep woodland.
The ground shakes first, then I appear.
Carcharodontosaurus is here.

lines.zh: 这片河口，从今天起换主人。
lines.en: This river mouth has a new master from today.

lines.zh: 我把脚掌踏进你的视野。
lines.en: I plant my feet into your view.

lines.zh: 远远听见我的脚步了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear my steps from far off?

lines.zh: 我带着旧伤和更锋利的牙来了。
lines.en: I arrive with old scars and sharper teeth.

lines.zh: 大树让开，我挤进这片林子。
lines.en: The trees give way as I push into this forest.

lines.zh: 我叫鲨齿龙，记住这名字。
lines.en: I am Carcharodontosaurus; remember it.

lines.zh: 我的长影盖住了整条小径。
lines.en: My long shadow covers the whole trail.

lines.zh: 从林子边缘，我慢慢迈出。
lines.en: I step slowly out from the forest edge.
The air along the bank has gone cold.
I slap my tail against a trunk.
I do not like the smell of this place.
I'm here, so stop looking for me.
This is a new hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我抬高头，让所有生物看见。
lines.en: I raise my head for every creature to see.

lines.zh: 大兽登场的规矩，都懂吧。
lines.en: You all know how a great beast arrives.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过我的鳞，焦味难闻。
lines.en: Flames lick my scales and the stench is foul.

lines.zh: 我从高处跌落，长身子砸在地上。
lines.en: I fall from above, my long body slamming down.

lines.zh: 河口的水灌进我喉咙了。
lines.en: River water pours down my throat.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的侧腹掀得发麻。
lines.en: The blast leaves my flank numb.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我脖子侧面。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the side of my neck.

lines.zh: 这种古怪的光，烧得我头皮发紧。
lines.en: This strange light tightens my scalp.

lines.zh: 饿得我连咬树的力气都没了。
lines.en: So hungry I can't even bite a tree.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，脊骨都在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my spine rattles.

lines.zh: 虚空拖着我，往没有地面的地方去。
lines.en: The void drags me where there is no ground.
